main_result.title: The rare-mismatch portfolio can be made jointly robust to fractional process scores and to a new predictably weighted average-conditional-mean contract without materially sacrificing the binary design gains.

fractional_score_extension.design: six tolerances from 0.1% to 5%, total score s from 0 to 50 in 0.1 increments; 3006 scenarios
fractional_score_extension.finding: A five-component portfolio [0.47,1.06,1.87,3.37,7.4] can be reweighted so that it is no later than the baseline on the finite grid while cutting worst excess delay versus the per-scenario single-lambda oracle by about 44%.
fractional_score_extension.dense_stress: Score step 0.01 on the six design tolerances and 101 log-spaced tolerances x 501 score values showed no material regression; maximum numerical excess versus baseline was about 2.7e-4 clusters or less, which is root/LP tolerance rather than an analytic continuum proof.

unified_portfolio.status: candidate profile only; default implementation not changed

predictably_weighted_average_contract.target: mu_w,t = sum_i w_i E[Y_i|F_{i-1}] / sum_i w_i
predictably_weighted_average_contract.requirements: Y_i in [0,1]; 0<w_i<=1; each w_i is fixed before current Y_i is observed
predictably_weighted_average_contract.proof: Convexity gives E exp(-lambda w_i Y_i)<=1-a_i mu_i, where a_i=1-exp(-lambda w_i). Since 1-x<=exp(-x) and (1-exp(-lambda w))/w is decreasing on (0,1], the denominator product is at most exp(-(1-exp(-lambda))*sum_i w_i mu_i). Therefore the displayed component at the true weighted average is pathwise dominated by a nonnegative supermartingale; a fixed mixture inherits Ville validity.
predictably_weighted_average_contract.simulation_sanity: 30,000 trajectories x 500 clusters under three adaptive/exogenous predictable-weight patterns gave ever-crossing rates 3.773%, 0.0067%, and 0%; proof, not simulation, is the validity basis.

measurement_boundary: Unequal process sizes do not matter to the equal-process estimand if each process contributes one bounded score; the process remains the unit.
Request-weighted reliability is a different estimand. Realized process size must not be silently used as a weight when it can depend on the current outcome.

When possible, prospectively fixed equal-size exposure blocks are preferable: they directly target exposure-weighted reliability while retaining the tighter equal-weight construction, and cross-block dependence is allowed by the conditional-mean theorem.

If unequal prospective exposure weights are unavoidable, normalize by a predeclared cap and use the weighted construction; cap exceedance must fail closed or start a separately declared generation rather than trigger retrospective renormalization.

external_alignment: Ryu and Wornell (2024) develop mixture/universal gambling portfolios for time-uniform bounded inference, supporting the general ex-ante portfolio design idea.

Howard et al. (2021) and related confidence-sequence work provide the broader predictable-weight/martingale concentration context, but the specific weighted-average rare-mismatch domination above is derived here and should be scoped to its stated assumptions.

Mineiro and Howard (NeurIPS 2023) show time-uniform inference for running averaged conditional distributions under nonstationarity and include importance-weighted extensions, reinforcing that weighting changes the estimand/contract rather than being a cosmetic post-processing step.
measurement_validity_rules: Treat equal-process and exposure/request-weighted reliability as distinct estimands and name which one a certificate controls.
A weight used inside a conditional e-process must be predictable with respect to the current outcome; a realized outcome-dependent cluster size is not automatically predictable.
Prefer prospective equal-size exposure blocks over retrospective size weighting when operationally possible.
A finite-grid no-regression optimization does not justify replacing defaults until continuum/broader-score stress and implementation tests are complete.
Do not select among candidate portfolios after observing current evaluation outcomes without a separate selection-valid mechanism.
scope_guards: The unified portfolio is synthetic-design optimized, not production-calibrated.
The dense no-regression checks are numerical stresses, not analytic continuum dominance proofs.
The weighted target is a weighted average conditional mean, not a fixed population parameter and not necessarily realized-request average if exposure is endogenous.
No forbidden semantic inputs were read.

frontier.action: Derive and test an exact or tighter predictable-weight construction that retains more of the bounded-chord rare-event advantage under unequal weights; compare it against the conservative weighted prototype.
Formalize prospective equal-size exposure blockization under adaptive process termination and determine exactly which observed-block estimand remains anytime-valid without survivor bias.
Build the lifetime-valid fingerprint generation/lease state machine using average-conditional-mean inference by default and stable-p only under independently justified constancy.
Continue public trace search for token-to-score/sign propagation under repeated inference.

frontier.exact_next_action: Seek a tighter weighted-average e-process that uses the individual predictable weights without collapsing them to the conservative minimum slope 1-exp(-lambda), and test whether it materially reduces effective exposure needed under highly unequal process sizes.
